note: Model table. Tuning a model, adding one, or changing a price is a data change, not a code change. Prices are USD per million tokens as published; they move, and a stale price is a wrong cost report - `argus models` prints what this file says so the number in a report can always be traced to a line here. `superseded_by` names the published successor: role selection drops a model whose successor this machine can call, so a cost policy cannot reach past the current generation. It is a successor relation, not a capability ranking - nothing here claims one model is smarter than another.

claude-opus-5-5.note: current Opus. Published 2026-11-03 at 4.00/20.00 per MTok

claude-sonnet-5-5.note: current Sonnet. Published 2026-11-03 at 2.00/10.00 per MTok

claude-haiku-5-5.note: current Haiku. 0.10/0.50 per MTok for prompts up to 100K tokens and 0.50/2.50 above it - this table holds one pair, so a long-prompt run under-reports by 5x. Published 2026-11-03

claude-sonnet-4-5.note: DEPRECATED - retires 2026-11-30. Use claude-sonnet-5-5. Its price is left as recorded because no current published figure covers it

claude-opus-4-5.note: previous generation, still served. 15.00/75.00 is what this table has always said and no current published figure covers this model, so it is left alone rather than guessed at - every current Opus is cheaper

claude-haiku-4-5.note: previous generation, still served. 1.00/5.00 matches the published figure as of 2026-11-03

local.note: A loopback OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM). Never chosen by --role unless ARGUS_LOCAL_API_KEY or OLLAMA_API_KEY is set: the price is zero, so cost ordering would otherwise pick it over every paid model, and an OPENAI_API_KEY is not evidence that a server is listening on this machine. Set the variable to any non-empty value when one is.

roles.planner: picks what to probe next from recorded evidence - a wrong call here costs the engagement, not money
roles.breadth: recon and enumeration: many cheap calls over a wide surface
roles.depth: exploitation and verification: must hold a long chain of reasoning about one target
roles.judge: reviews a finding. Must not be the family that produced it - two models that agree because they share a prior are not a check
roles.writer: report prose from recorded findings; invents nothing
